prompt:

Visual Style (ch_sticker_pop): Bold 2D sticker-pop cartoon illustration: thick smooth black outlines with a chunky white sticker border around every main object, saturated flat fills in lemon yellow (#FFD23F), coral (#FF6B6B), teal (#2EC4B6) and grape (#7B2CBF) on a single flat solid pastel background (#FFF6D6 or #DFF7F4); simple exaggerated proportions, big expressive eyes, comic motion lines and sparkle marks, orthographic 2D, no gradients, no realistic textures, no 3D. Palette: #FFF6D6, #FFD23F, #FF6B6B, #2EC4B6, #7B2CBF.

Character Cast: Mascot 'Bé Ủa': a round lemon-yellow (#FFD23F) blob creature with huge white oval eyes, tiny black pupils, a wide open mouth, two short stubby arms and a single curly antenna shaped like a question mark. Outfit: No clothing; tiny coral (#FF6B6B) cheeks, chunky white sticker border.

Scene Composition: The channel character stands centered in the frame, pointing upwards with a welcoming smile. Clean, minimalist composition with at least 60% open negative space on the solid flat background.

Emphasis lettering instruction: render exact uppercase Vietnamese hand-lettered text in the upper third integrated directly onto the flat canvas (strictly zero rectangular text cards, banners, or gradient overlays covering artwork): "BẢN ĐẦY ĐỦ TRÊN YOUTUBE" and "ỦA SAO VẬY?".
